name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.34-beta “Paris” (build 36) — a numbering per submission, and updates in place.
• New: one matter, many submissions. The Memorandum, the Notice of Dispute and the Statement of Claim each keep their own exhibit numbers. Submission → Numbering switches between them and creates new ones.
• A later submission can continue an earlier one: exhibits numbered there keep their numbers (shown in grey), and new exhibits follow on. It can also continue after numbers given outside LitArbi (e.g. C-78).
• The other side's numbers stay theirs: R-5 or RL-2 show in every submission and are never renumbered.
• Word asks once per document which submission it belongs to. Update from Brief can keep a filed submission's numbers. The List of Exhibits can show only the new exhibits.
• Updates now install themselves: LitArbi downloads the update in the background, checks it, and installs it when you click Relaunch Now or when you quit. No installer any more (from this build on).
• Build 35: Sync with the LitArbi Server after signing in.
